notes.title: New Menu and Tons of Holiday Skins!
notes.content:
To access Santa's Secret Safe, click the ornament in the bottom right corner. Guess the holiday related codes to unlock new festive skins!

Tips: 
-Think of popular sayings or holiday related things and songs.
-There are no spaces, numbers, symbols, or capital letters in the codes.
-Most are Christmas oriented, the rest are holidays as a whole.

Here are some codes to get you started! (These are the hardest ones to figure out)

ginger - Unlocks Gingerbread Cannon
nuclearwinter - Unlocks Santa Bomb
freezenova - Unlocks Ice Grenade

Good luck and have a Happy Cannoneer Christmas!

notes.title: Cannoneer Christmas 2024
notes.content: This Christmas, Cannoneer is getting packed full of new exclusive skins. If you don't have the game yet, get it soon because these skins are one of a kind, and after Christmas, you can never get them again!
